verdict.rationale: For a SaaS planning platform, headless automation means programmatic, non-UI operation. Pigment's own docs claim 'open APIs' and 'scheduled imports', and it offers an MCP server that lets external tools build and edit models without the UI, which together give thin first-party support for non-interactive automation. However, no CLI, CI integration, or API reference is evidenced, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Missing for 10: documented CLI or CI/CD pipeline integration, published API reference/spec for automating model runs, headless auth (service accounts/tokens) documentation, hands-on corroboration.
